how: each fact checked once by hand against the named independent source; scratch inputs: Portal JSON per propId, DCP PDFs in data/dcps/

zone.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) Land Zoning Map, checked 2026-10-19

height_m.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) Height of Buildings Map, checked 2026-10-19

fsr.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) Floor Space Ratio Map, checked 2026-10-19: no FSR map applies

min_lot_m2.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) Lot Size Map, checked 2026-10-19

lot_area_m2.source: lot boundary: Portal ePlanningApi/lot polygon, geodesic area (user ruling 2026-10-19: lot area = the boundary)

heritage.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) no Heritage Map layer intersects, checked 2026-10-19

flood_lep_map.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 2284140) no Flood Planning layer intersects, checked 2026-10-19

bushfire.source: RFS Bush Fire Prone Land (mapprod3 Fire/BFPL) intersect with the lot polygon: no feature

corner.source: NSW Transport Theme road segments within 12 m of the lot: EGRET WAY only (nearest other road >30 m)

setback_front_m.source: Camden DCP 2019 Part 4 Table 4-2 (pdf p11, P4-8): default = average of 2 nearest dwelling houses; 4.5 m (3.5 m fronting open space) only if there are not 2 within 40 m, lot <=900 m2

setback_rear_m.source: Camden DCP 2019 Part 4 Table 4-2 (pdf p11): 4 m single storey / single-storey portion; 6 m two-storey portion
